newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian bond spreads narrow post-tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian bond spreads narrow post-tender.

text.p: Australian bonds rallied in afternoon trading on Tuesday after an aggressively bid T-bond tender, reversing the recent spread widening against U.S. and Canadian debt, traders said.

The Australian/U.S. 10-year bond yield spread now stands at around Friday's 122 basis point close, having blown out to over 130 basis points amid the uncertainty of how the supply was going to be received.

The local market continues to outpace New Zealand bonds, which remain in the doldrums after last week's RBNZ economic report ruled out an early policy easing and amid caution ahead of next month's election.
